ShaderNodePreset.Description: Parametric wave blur — Petal, Lissajous, and Spiral kernel modes with twist and chromatic aberration.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: WaveBlur

Uniform.Tooltip: Kernel size in pixels. Controls overall blur radius.
Uniform.Name: size

Uniform.Tooltip: Kernel shape: 0 = Petal (rose curve), 1 = Lissajous (figure-8 / knot), 2 = Spiral (wavy Archimedean spiral)
Uniform.Name: mode

Uniform.Tooltip: Wave complexity. Petal: petal count (non-integers give spiral petals). Lissajous: x:y frequency ratio. Spiral: number of turns.
Uniform.Name: complexity

Uniform.Tooltip: Wave modulation depth. Petal: secondary petal ripple. Lissajous: phase offset (0=line, 0.5=figure-8, 1=knot). Spiral: how wavy the arms are (high values fold the arms back).
Uniform.Name: wave_amp

Uniform.Tooltip: Vortex twist. Quadratic — inner samples stay nearly fixed, outer samples sweep strongly. Genuinely different from Rotation: the core holds while the outer arms spiral. Combine with Rotation for offset vortex forms.
Uniform.Name: twist

Uniform.Tooltip: Global rotation of the kernel in degrees.
Uniform.Name: rotation

Uniform.Tooltip: Chromatic aberration. Scales the R and B sample positions slightly apart, adding colour fringing to the blur trails.
Uniform.Name: chroma

Uniform.Tooltip: Sample count. Higher = smoother. Lower = visible kernel structure (can look intentional at low counts).
Uniform.Name: samples
